Components: HS, CM Cost: 7 Chakra Keywords: Ninjutsu, Water Release, Fuinjutsu, Barrier Description: You create a dense spiraling bubble of water around a creature, capturing them inside and restraining their precise movement.

Losing contact causes the jutsu to end immediately. A creature loses contact by being moved further than 5 feet away from the target.

The bubble containing a creature can be moved as an Action on behalf of the caster, as they drag it with them as part of their movement. If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to make a captured creatures Saving throws to escape this jutsu at disadvantage.
